name: Crimson Flow (Judgment Ring Momentum)
author: Nocturne
description: Chain Perfect Judgment Ring strikes across SH1, SH2: Covenant & SH3: FTNW for escalating Cash, Bonus EXP, or Party HP Surges with a pinned Gothic Flow Streak HUD and persistent best-streak tracking.

settings.label: Cash Reward Multiplier
settings.description: Scale bonus Cash earned from Perfect Strike chains

settings.label: Party HP / EXP Surge
settings.description: Grant bonus Party HP Surge (SH2/SH3) or Bonus EXP (SH1) on Perfect Strikes

settings.label: Pinned Flow Streak HUD
settings.description: Display your live Crimson Flow streak and all-time best in the corner HUD

settings.label: Streak Shatter Callout
settings.description: Show a Gothic toast when a Ring miss breaks an active Flow streak
